mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM medical_case c JOIN patient_profile p ON p.id = c.patient_id WHERE p.account_user_id = #{userId}

SELECT c.id AS caseId, c.case_no AS caseNo, c.eye_side AS eyeSide, c.workflow_status AS workflowStatus, (SELECT latest_image.quality_status FROM image_file latest_image WHERE latest_image.case_id = c.id AND latest_image.status != 'DELETED' ORDER BY latest_image.updated_at DESC, latest_image.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS qualityStatus, (SELECT COALESCE( JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(quality_result.result_json, '$.reasonCode')), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(quality_result.result_json, '$.reason'))) FROM analysis_task quality_task LEFT JOIN analysis_result quality_result ON quality_result.task_id = quality_task.id WHERE quality_task.case_id = c.id AND quality_task.task_type = 'IMAGE_QUALITY_CHECK' ORDER BY quality_task.updated_at DESC, quality_task.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS qualityReason, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_task report_task JOIN analysis_result report_result ON report_result.task_id = report_task.id JOIN analysis_report report ON report.result_id = report_result.id WHERE report_task.case_id = c.id AND report.status = 'SIGNED') AS signedReportCount, c.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM medical_case c JOIN patient_profile p ON p.id = c.patient_id WHERE p.account_user_id = #{userId}
ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT c.id AS caseId, c.case_no AS caseNo, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM image_file image WHERE image.case_id = c.id AND image.status != 'DELETED') AS imageCount, (SELECT latest_image.quality_status FROM image_file latest_image WHERE latest_image.case_id = c.id AND latest_image.status != 'DELETED' ORDER BY latest_image.updated_at DESC, latest_image.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS qualityStatus, (SELECT COALESCE( JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(quality_result.result_json, '$.reasonCode')), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(quality_result.result_json, '$.reason'))) FROM analysis_task quality_task LEFT JOIN analysis_result quality_result ON quality_result.task_id = quality_task.id WHERE quality_task.case_id = c.id AND quality_task.task_type = 'IMAGE_QUALITY_CHECK' ORDER BY quality_task.updated_at DESC, quality_task.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS qualityReason, (SELECT segmentation_task.status FROM analysis_task segmentation_task WHERE segmentation_task.case_id = c.id AND segmentation_task.task_type = 'VESSEL_SEGMENTATION' ORDER BY segmentation_task.updated_at DESC, segmentation_task.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS analysisStatus, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_task report_task JOIN analysis_result report_result ON report_result.task_id = report_task.id JOIN analysis_report report ON report.result_id = report_result.id WHERE report_task.case_id = c.id AND report.status = 'SIGNED') AS signedReportCount, c.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM medical_case c JOIN patient_profile p ON p.id = c.patient_id WHERE p.account_user_id = #{userId} AND c.status != 'DELETED' AND (c.case_no = #{caseReference} OR (#{caseId} IS NOT NULL AND c.id = #{caseId})) LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_report report JOIN analysis_result result ON result.id = report.result_id JOIN analysis_task task ON task.id = result.task_id JOIN medical_case c ON c.id = task.case_id JOIN patient_profile p ON p.id = c.patient_id WHERE p.account_user_id = #{userId} AND c.status != 'DELETED' AND report.status = 'SIGNED'
AND (c.case_no = #{caseReference} OR (#{caseId} IS NOT NULL AND c.id = #{caseId}))

SELECT c.id AS caseId, c.case_no AS caseNo, result.id AS resultId, report.version, report.signed_at AS signedAt, report.signer_name_snapshot AS signerName, review.findings, review.conclusion, review.recommendation FROM analysis_report report JOIN analysis_result result ON result.id = report.result_id JOIN analysis_task task ON task.id = result.task_id JOIN medical_case c ON c.id = task.case_id JOIN patient_profile p ON p.id = c.patient_id JOIN analysis_review review ON review.result_id = result.id WHERE p.account_user_id = #{userId} AND c.status != 'DELETED' AND report.status = 'SIGNED'
AND (c.case_no = #{caseReference} OR (#{caseId} IS NOT NULL AND c.id = #{caseId}))
AND result.id = #{resultId} AND report.version = #{version} ORDER BY report.signed_at DESC, report.id DESC LIMIT 1
